children: announced on Wednesday that its wholly owned subsidiary, IQVIA, priced an offering of $2B in aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2034.

The proceeds from the notes offering will be used to redeem in full the issuer’s Senior 5.000% Notes due 2026, to repay a portion of the outstanding indebtedness under the issuer's revolving credit facility, and to pay fees and expenses related to the notes offering, the company highlighted.

The notes will bear interest at 6.375% per annum and will pay interest semi-annually in arrears on March 15 and September 15 of each year, beginning on March 15, 2027. The notes will mature on March 15, 2034, unless earlier repurchased or redeemed in accordance with their terms, the company added.
The issuance of the Notes is expected to occur on or about September 23, 2026.

title: IQVIA prices $2B of senior notes due 2034
